path.data-subject-role: Single monocular eyepiece joined to tube; no second ocular/magnification text.
Body-tube visible boundary; lower and arm interfaces use shared/hidden edges,not physical air.
Lower tube edge between arm interface and objective turret.
Selected rotating nosepiece with one visible active objective; other barrels outside this simplified view.
Downward active objective; terminates ABOVE specimen stage,not through it.
Connected support arm; tube interface hidden and base/stage shared interfaces explicit.
Left visible base top meeting arm at actual junction.
Remaining base contour meeting arm at actual junction; shared top under arm drawn once.
Separate specimen platform with sloped rear contact shared with arm; aperture/3D optical clearance unresolved.
ONE slanted substage mirror/holder sectional reference,not a modern lamp.
Actual displayed support joining mirror corner to arm front; no free floating mirror.
Outer front-face focus control attached in arm projection,not a hole or detached sphere.
Inner coaxial fine-focus control; attachment external-keyed,no hidden axle proof.
